Remove ambient counts from each cell (mass-conserving).

Source: R/correct.R
correct_counts.Rd

Remove ambient counts from each cell (mass-conserving).

Usage

correct_counts(
  observed,
  soup,
  rho,
  method = c("subtract", "redistribute", "bayes", "bayes_cell"),
  clusters = NULL,
  max_iter = 50,
  drop_zeros = TRUE,
  cap_q = 0.001
)

Arguments

observed

genes x cells counts (base matrix or dgCMatrix).

soup

length-G ambient probability vector (one soup for all cells; for per-sample soups use decant()).

rho

length-cells contamination fractions.

method

one of "subtract", "redistribute", "bayes", "bayes_cell" (see Details).

clusters

cluster labels, required for the two bayes methods.

max_iter

iterations for "redistribute".

drop_zeros

for sparse input, drop entries corrected to exactly 0. FALSE keeps the input's sparsity pattern (explicit zeros).

cap_q

for "bayes_cell": an entry is treated as not explainable by ambient RNA when its count exceeds the 1 - cap_q Poisson quantile of its ambient expectation.

Value

corrected counts, same class as observed (dense or dgCMatrix). Guaranteed 0 <= corrected <= observed element-wise.

Details

See the header of R/correct.R for the rules and gate_correction() for how they compare against ground truth.
